# iOS changes an event another device changed meanwhile: If-Match with the
# old ETag (also a wrong or a weak one) is 412 and the content stays.
@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics

# Another device moves the event first.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 204

# This one still holds the old ETag.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 412

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist-moved.ics

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:weekly-team.ics}
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 412

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: W/{etag:dentist-moved.ics}
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 412

# If-Match on an entry that does not exist.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/new.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: weekly-team.ics
< status 412

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist-moved.ics
< header ETag {etag:dentist-moved.ics}

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/new.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404
